_doc: Copy to config/local.json (gitignored). Per-host values only; secrets are REFERENCES resolved by ops/fleet_kit/fleet_secrets.py, never a literal value here.

loop._doc: tools/al_loop.py tick. inbox_dir / outbox_dir: blank = <repo>/moon_sync_inbox and <repo>/moon_sync_outbox. max_notes_per_day: kit item 14 cap 12 (may lower, never raise; ORDER / FIX / RULING exempt). max_new_plans_per_day: ROADMAP rows an idle deep-dive may propose per day. dest_inboxes {CODE: dir}: where a reply is byte-copied (else the fleet roster). routes {kind: {model, effort}}: incident override of the ROUTES table (invalid entries ignored).

_doc_core: server.al and the overlay read these top-level keys. client_log: blank = auto-discover the Steam install's logs/Client.txt (read only, after consent). character: optional name filter. poll_ms: tail poll interval. overlay_toggle: Electron accelerator for show/hide. eval_hotkey: Electron accelerator for the item check (reads the clipboard once per press). port: null = 8960 (block 8960-8979).
